acceptance: SnapshotStore accepts a WeeklyRadarSnapshot once, rejects duplicate SnapshotId, and preserves insertion order for historical records.
Snapshot retrieval returns the exact supplied as_of, evidence cutoff, universe snapshot, model version, and scoring version without recomputation or mutation.
The store port and in-memory implementation remain provider-agnostic and do not know Telegram, rendering, scheduling, retry, external persistence, or credentials.
The application layer registers the SnapshotStore boundary without changing WR-001 Domain types or adding dependencies.
Focused unit and integration tests cover append-only behavior, duplicate identity rejection, stable retrieval order, metadata retention, and empty history.
The design spec and execution plan record historical integrity, exclusions, authorization, current-WI issue policy, and verification commands.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Keep Snapshot Store independent of external systems and other feature implementations.
Snapshot identity is immutable: reject reuse rather than overwrite historical data.
Preserve supplied metadata and insertion order; do not recalculate research conclusions.
Keep external persistence, rendering, delivery, retry, receipt, and scheduling outside this Contract.
Do not add dependencies for this Contract.
Resolve issues within the current Work Item when they remain inside its Contract scope; open a successor only for a distinct or materially expanded boundary.
Do not introduce trading, price prediction, target price, portfolio allocation, or capital-action behavior.

intent.problem: Weekly Radar has a snapshot identity boundary but no append-only store that can preserve one computed snapshot for later rendering, delivery, and retry without recomputation.
constraints: Accept only a fully formed WeeklyRadarSnapshot and retain all supplied metadata exactly.
Reject duplicate SnapshotId instead of overwriting historical state; preserve insertion order for deterministic history reads.
The store is an in-memory application boundary for this WI; external persistence and delivery remain out of scope.
intent.rationale: An append-only Snapshot Store makes the Compute → Persist → Render → Publish sequence testable and gives later WIs one stable historical identity to reuse on retry.
